title: 第21章 竟然是你第22章 两位漫游者
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 一柄雕刻着美丽花纹，寒光四射的软剑刺在勇者断剑的剑身上，磨出了大片火星。
这是双方第三次碰撞了，每一次敌人都会从齐格飞的视线死角处杀出，角度刁钻地直取他的命门。
如果不是齐格飞身上还有【天风之舞】的加成，现在已经变成异世界大地的生物化肥了。
达伦给他施加的【天风之舞】着实效果显着，这个四阶魔法不仅仅只是提高施加对象的动作速度，还会增强对象的反应速度，也就是直接提高敏捷等级。
魔法的效果会随着时间的推移而慢慢减弱，齐格飞出发时敏捷等级直接飙到了A+，但现在已经掉到了b，恐怕再有个几分钟就要打回原形了。
到时候他就是个综合评价c级的战五渣，死期也就到了。
（怎么办？怎么办？这样下去要出事，得想想办法。）
思考间，他又险而又险躲过了从侧后方袭来的软剑。
但这次，软剑的剑锋划破了齐格飞的外衣，在他的腰间留下一条浅浅的血痕。直到现在，他甚至都没看清楚对方的样子。
（完犊子了，真的要顶不住了！）
生死一线间，齐格飞终于想出了破局的方法。
“夏侬！夏侬！快救我！”
求助史官妈妈！
夏侬系统那机械平淡，毫无感情的声音在齐格飞的脑海里响了起来。
【正在为您查找逃生路线。】
佛祖在上，齐格飞一辈子都没听过这么好听的声音。
【查找完毕，无逃生可能。】
“草泥马！”
齐格飞实在没忍住一口国粹就爆了出来。
【但您无需逃生，摘下兜帽露出真容即可解此危局。】
夏侬掐着古风腔，怎么听怎么欠揍。
齐格飞的眼睛一下就亮了起来。
（对哦，在这个世界我的外貌可以拿来唬人啊。）
奇兰大陆，黑发黑瞳是勇者家族的标志，这是个人尽皆知的常识。至少到目前为止，还没有出现过梅兰家族以外的人有这样的基因特征。
卡塔丽娜和罗兰都是被齐格飞的外貌唬住，陷入了严重的思想迪化。其实他们只要随便来一刀，就能把这位神秘强大的“梅兰大人”砍翻在地。
齐格飞当即解开了兜帽，露出了自己的脸。
下一秒，环绕着他全身的那种针尖般的压迫感突然消失了，连呼吸都通畅了不少。
（好！唬住了！）
齐格飞在心中欢呼雀跃。
正午的阳光穿透茂密的树丛，在地上留下一片的斑驳的光影。两只游雀从空中飞过，整片树林都陷入了诡异的寂静中。
良久，一个清冷的声音传来，虽然对方极力掩饰但齐格飞依旧听出了话语中的诧异。
content_en:
A soft sword engraved with beautiful patterns and radiating cold light stabbed the sword of the brave man's broken sword, grinding out large sparks.
This was the third time the two sides collided. Each time, the enemy would come out of the blind spot of Siegfried's sight and attack his life gate at a tricky angle.
If Siegfried hadn't had the bonus of [Dance of the Sky Wind], he would have become a biological fertilizer for the land of another world.
The [Dance of Heavenly Wind] cast by Darren on him is really effective. This level 4 magic not only increases the movement speed of the target, but also enhances the target's reaction speed, which directly increases the agility level.
The effect of magic will gradually weaken over time. Siegfried's agility level soared to A+ when he set off, but now it has dropped to B, and he may be back to his original form in a few minutes.
By then, he will be a C-level scumbag, and his death will come soon.
(What should I do? What should I do? Something will happen if this continues, so I have to think of a way.)
While thinking, he narrowly dodged the soft sword coming from the side and behind.
But this time, the edge of the soft sword cut through Siegfried's coat, leaving a shallow blood mark on his waist. Until now, he hadn't even seen the other party clearly.
(I’m so fucked up, I really can’t stand it anymore!)
In the thin line between life and death, Siegfried finally figured out a way to break the situation.
"Shannon! Shannon! Help me!"
Ask the historian’s mother for help!
The mechanical, plain, emotionless voice of the Shannon system rang in Siegfried's mind.
[Looking for an escape route for you. 】
Lord Buddha, Siegfried has never heard such a pleasant sound in his life.
[Search completed, no escape possible. 】
"Grass mud horse!"
Siegfried really couldn't hold back and burst out with a mouthful of national quintessence.
[But you don’t need to escape. You can resolve this crisis by taking off your hood and revealing your true face. 】
Shannon speaks in an ancient accent, but no matter how hard she listens, she deserves a beating.
Siegfried's eyes lit up immediately.
(Yes, in this world my appearance can be used to bluff people.)
In Qilan Continent, black hair and black eyes are the symbol of the brave family. This is common knowledge to everyone. At least so far, no one outside the Meilan family has had such genetic characteristics.
Katarina and Roland were both frightened by Siegfried's appearance and fell into serious ideological transformation. In fact, they could chop this mysterious and powerful "Lord Mei Lan" to the ground with just one strike.
Siegfried immediately opened his hood and revealed his face.
The next second, the needle-like pressure surrounding his whole body suddenly disappeared, and even his breathing became much easier.
(Okay! Frightened!)
Siegfried cheered in his heart.
The midday sun penetrated the dense trees, leaving a patch of mottled light and shadow on the ground. Two wandering birds flew through the sky, and the entire forest fell into an eerie silence.
After a long time, a cold voice came. Although the other party tried his best to hide it, Siegfried still heard the surprise in the words.
title_en: Chapter 21 It’s You Chapter 22 Two Wanderers
